# Tool — Creative Consultancy
> Brand identity, web design, and web development. New York.

## About
Tool is a design and development consultancy based in New York, working with clients globally.  From scroll-stopping identities to robust back-office automation pipelines, Tool services the full spectrum of growth-oriented tools businesses need to succeed.

## Services

### Brand Identity Design
Logo design, visual systems, typography, color palettes, and brand guidelines. Creating organic brand identities for businesses looking to gain a sustainable, measurable advantage.

### Web Design
Responsive website design from concept to launch. User experience design, visual design, prototyping in Figma, and production-ready implementation.

### Web Development
Custom web development and web applications using performant web frameworks, robust and secure business logic, paired with scalable deployment and operations architechture.

## Key Facts
- Location: New York, NY
- Industries: Technology, Creative, B2B Services, Startups
- Approach: Direct, collaborative, technical, no agency bloat.
- Contact: admin@tool.nyc
- Booking: https://tool.nyc/book
- Portfolio: https://tool.nyc/#work

## Process
Projects range from brand refreshes to full web applications and automation. We work directly with founders and business leaders, focusing on strategic creative consulting and technical implementation.
